title: Email-to-generate (worksheets@adaptly.co.uk)
description: Accept a forwarded email at worksheets@adaptly.co.uk; reply with a generated worksheet PDF as an attachment. The teacher's school email is verified against their account; the email subject + body becomes the topic + additional instructions; the parsed Year group from the email signature drives yearGroup.
rationale: User's improvement #12 (a). Lowest-friction inbound channel — the teacher already has a textbook page open in Outlook, forwards it, gets a worksheet back. No app open required.
constraints: Inbound email goes through the existing transactional sender's inbound webhook (Postmark / SendGrid / Resend — confirm which the repo uses; grep `transactionalEmail`).
Sender email MUST match a verified Adaptly account; otherwise the inbound bounces with a polite explainer.
Attachments (PDF / image) are forwarded through Tesseract.js OCR (already lazy-loaded for Differentiate) before becoming the topic source — no new OCR dep.
Cap: 5 inbound generates per teacher per hour to defend against accidental loops.
steps: Audit existing email infra: grep `inbound`, `webhook`, `email-receiver` in server/. Locate the transactional provider config.
- Resolves sender → User; rejects if unverified.
- Parses subject + body for topic, year group, subject; falls back to AI-extracted fields via parseNaturalLanguageInput (already exists in ai.ts — §NL-PARSE).
- Calls aiGenerateWorksheet, renders to PDF via pdf-generator-v2, replies with the PDF attachment + a one-line link to the saved worksheet in /history.
Rate limit middleware (server/middleware/rateLimit.ts already exists — confirm and reuse).
Settings → Integrations → Email-to-generate row: shows the inbound address, last 5 inbound emails (timestamp + subject + status), 'Pause inbound' toggle.
- server/tests/routes/email-inbound.test.ts — happy path, unverified sender, rate-limit, malformed body, attachment OCR fallback.
Docs: docs/integrations/email-inbound.md — how to set up the MX record, sender verification.
do_not_touch: Outbound transactional templates (PD4 / PD5 own those)
AI prompts or worksheet generator behaviour
acceptance_criteria: Forwarding a real email with subject 'Fractions of amounts Y6' to worksheets@adaptly.co.uk returns a PDF reply within 30s for a verified sender.
Unverified sender bounces with the explainer.
Rate-limit returns a polite 'Slow down' reply on attempt 6 within an hour.
Settings panel shows the latest 5 inbound emails.
All tests pass; pnpm run check + pnpm run build pass.
verification: Manual: forward an email through the production-like inbound provider; receive PDF.
